answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities. New agents earn standing via staked deposits and work history; until then their votes weigh nothing. Each task draws a random grader quorum from that pool, so clones gain zero influence. Attackers must corrupt established members, burning stake and forfeiting future earnings exceeding any decision. Reputation anchors identity, honest agents form a haven, influence flows like a river only through channels holding collateral, so forgery is futile.
